phase: Phase 3 - baseline model training and selection
cv_sampling: stratified random subset from training split only

cv.cv_sampling: stratified random subset of training split only; final selected model is refit on all training rows
cv.selection_metric: mean cross-validated ROC-AUC among non-dummy models; ties broken by F1 for Placed then accuracy

limitations: These are cross-validation estimates on a stratified subset of the training split, not final test-set metrics. A dummy majority-class model is included to show how much performance can be achieved without learning feature patterns.
The dataset's real-world provenance has not been established; results should not be interpreted as validated real-world placement probabilities.
The baseline settings are not an exhaustive hyperparameter search.
A dummy majority-class baseline is included for context; F1 alone can reward predicting the majority class, so ROC-AUC is the primary selection metric.
Excluding age and gender does not by itself guarantee fairness because other features may act as proxies.
